title: fix(release): stale-prompts reads the unfiltered run list too, and says what it read
body:
Closes #20659

Clause-②: no (no `packages/spec` surface).

`stale-prompts` no longer rests on the server's `?status=waiting` filter alone. `collectWaitingRuns` also reads the unfiltered run list back 30 days (GitHub's own cap on a job waiting at an environment), reads every run the filter names or the list shows unfinished directly, and judges only that direct read. A filter omission, a filter `total_count` above what it listed, or a list read cut at its page cap is printed as a `::warning::`. The step summary names all three readings on every run, "none waiting" included, so the first main push after this lands is the in-run measurement triage step 1 asked for.

Self-test: 43 cases across 12 batteries green at 2f9461fecc. Ablation (judge only the filter's runs) turns 3 cases red, the triage pin first.
